All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position on this Site Development and Hosting Agreement (we are the Company/customer; HDI is the vendor):

**Critical gaps (inserted):**
- **LOL-CAP** — no liability provision of any kind; added a mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees / USD 1M), consequential-damages exclusion and uncapped Excluded Claims.
- **INDEMN** — no indemnity at all; added HDI's IP/breach-of-law/data-incident/misconduct indemnity with a narrow reciprocal indemnity limited to our Content.
- **IP** — ownership of the Site work product and customer data is unallocated despite HDI building and hosting it; added a Section 5.5 vesting deliverables, Marks and customer data in us with a licence-back of HDI's platform IP.

**High-severity deviations:**
- **NONCOMPETE / EXCLUSIVITY** — Section 6.1 restricts our business in "substantially similar products" and gives HDI full-term exclusivity over our branded channel; narrowed the restraint and added a performance-based exit.
- **LD** — Section 4.2's termination payment (50% of our Net Sales above $800k) is an uncapped penalty on us; capped at 3 months' fees and disapplied on HDI default.
- **T4C** — our convenience exit sits at 90 days and is penalised; reduced to 30 days without penalty, HDI's right confined to end of term.
- **ASSIGN** and **LICENSE** — bare successors clause and a grant that excludes affiliates/contractors; both tightened.

**Medium/low:** RENEWAL (90-day window shortened, reminder added), AUDIT (annual cap, confidentiality, no system access), WARRANTY (only authority reps existed — performance warranty added), GOVLAW (NY law fine; venue added), INSURANCE and TRANSITION (both absent — inserted).

**Compliant, no redline:** MFN (Section 1.8 runs in our favour), NOSOLICIT (none present), MINCOMMIT (pure revenue share, no take-or-pay).
